summary: About page CMS feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (public GET without auth, admin GET/PUT 401 without token, 400 when founder missing, 422 on empty name, save returns updated_at/updated_by, new profile gets 12-char id, hidden profile and mission:false are reflected on the public endpoint, client cannot fake 'locked', founder can be hidden). Frontend admin /admin/team: 2 profiles shown, founder badge appears and founder delete button is disabled. Add → fill → save shows a toast and the new card appears on /about as about-leader-1. Hide → save removes it from /about. Delete opens the dialog; Cancel keeps the profile; Confirm removes it and shows a toast, leaving only Radha on /about. Mission text edit shows on /about. Vision hidden → no about-vision element. Everything restored. Public /about checked at 1920 and 390: owner card and photos, leadership card with /images/radha-rajput.jpeg loaded, two mission/vision cards, 0px horizontal overflow. Regression: team-text-form, team-photos-section and team-save are present; the homepage team section renders.

minor.issue: No check for duplicate profile ids, and the founder can be moved away from index 0 (the public page still handles this because it finds the founder by id). Low risk.

issues: ImageUpload 'All files' button text wraps onto 2 lines ('All / files') and looks cramped next to 'Change' in the narrow photo column

action_items: Optional: widen the photo column or stack the ImageUpload buttons in the AdminAboutContent ProfileCard
Optional: confirmDelete PUTs the whole editor state, so any unsaved edits to other profiles or mission are published along with the delete. Consider warning the user or saving only the delete.
critical_code_review_comments: confirmDelete in AdminAboutContent.jsx sends the full local state `a`, which includes unsaved edits, so deleting a profile also publishes pending edits

About.jsx FounderHero hardcodes the 'Years' label and the experience text and ignores highlight_label, so editing the founder's highlight label has no effect in the hero card (the photos tile does use it)
seed_data_creation: None kept. Before testing there was no settings{key:'about'} doc (defaults were served). The final state is a doc whose content is identical to DEFAULT_ABOUT (founder + Radha visible, original mission/vision), so updated_at is now set in the admin UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_about_content.py reads the admin JWT from /tmp/jwt (mint it with the command in the review request) and restores the content in module teardown. The UI test uses localStorage/sessionStorage injection plus a Chrome UA. A 'Notifications are blocked' modal with a 'Later' button shows on admin pages.
